parent_objective: audit whether M1322 and M1327 should be merged as an additive source corpus
blocked_by: M1327 is source-positive but under target as a standalone replacement and halfshaft/global friction remain inactive

public_gates: M1328 must not use private holdout
M1328 must preserve actor input contract
M1328 must not use naive additive counts as final merged counts
M1328 must keep global friction and halfshaft blockers explicit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not fabricate global friction coverage
do not treat M1327 alone as a replacement corpus
do not claim merged corpus readiness without dedupe or identity audit

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M1327 should be used as additive top-up over M1322 rather than as replacement
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit uses naive counts as final merged evidence
stop if audit hides halfshaft or global friction blockers
stop if audit routes directly to PPO
stop if audit changes actor inputs
fallback_plan: if additive merge is admissible, route to merge/export implementation
if additive merge is not admissible, route to family-specific halfshaft/global-friction repair audit
if identity dedupe is ambiguous, implement a merge preview tool before export
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1327 source-positive but under-target top-up smoke completes

admission_evidence: M1322 has 216 accepted rows across seven families
M1327 has 150 accepted rows across six families
M1327 enriches load/CG and brake asymmetry
M1327 loses halfshaft and global friction remains missing
blocked_shortcuts: do not use naive counts as final merge counts
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: global friction and halfshaft blockers are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1328 audits source rows and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit source rows for later command-response history materialization
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1322 source export and M1327 top-up smoke.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If merge is not admissible, record the source-construction gap rather than routing to policy training.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: M1327 is better used as an additive top-up over M1322 than as a replacement corpus, but this must be audited before export or materialization.
success_criteria: audit compares M1322 and M1327 family counts
audit states naive additive total and its limitations
audit keeps global friction and halfshaft blockers explicit
audit chooses merge/export, further repair, or merge-preview route
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit treats naive additive counts as final merged counts
audit hides halfshaft or global friction blockers
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write docs/m1328-paper-route-source-topup-additive-merge-audit.md from M1322 and M1327 artifacts

decision_rule: M1328 passes if it audits M1327 as additive top-up evidence and chooses a next source route without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, hidden blockers, or actor-input expansion.
